regions.full_page: Anna Smolinska 23 - 6344 Dubois - leakage of heart since one year old, can not hold any food in stommach. Enrolled this evening per- petually - Next evening reported no change. P.S. Aug. 9th '28 Above noted A.S. was enrolled again the following year after speci- alists from all over had given up hopes. "Nothing can be done" She recovers quite normal so as to be anxious to get work in factory.
